integrity: The lower bound comes from exact four-vertex distinguisher sets for same-side crown vertices. Equality forces a deleted-matching transversal. A separately proved one-hole transversal lemma classifies exactly when deleting any selected landmark leaves a mixed resolving set, yielding the orientation threshold and complete basis count. The verifier directly checks mixed-element distance vectors and the one-hole lemma.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for crown graphs with n at least four; the six-cycle boundary n=3 is excluded.
Only one-landmark fault tolerance for mixed vertex-edge resolution is covered.
Ordinary fault-tolerant metric dimension, fault-tolerant edge metric dimension, and higher deletion tolerance are not claimed.
Finite exhaustive verification for 4 <= n <= 9 is corroborative only.
A differently named or non-indexed crown-graph result could exist despite targeted alias searches.
title: Mixed fault-tolerant metric bases of crown graphs
